Proof Router is on the production path: planProofRoute() selects before execution, runtime runs only selected verifiers and records omitted reasons.

platform-contracts.json is the single canonical host registry v2 with eight canonical HostIds; independent host arrays and stale Mimocode removed.
One HostAdapter contract shared by CLI runtime and platform projections; duplicate contracts merged with a time-boxed compatibility shim.

DeepSeek Harness native integration: platforms/deepseek-harness adapter and package/bundle installed via official dsh plugin/profile lifecycle; bounded context, hard tool policy, event/evidence, approval/sandbox/subagent/MCP/headless mapping; bundle hash and config fingerprint verified before every supervised launch; DSH turn completion is host observation, never terminal PASS.

Command Code native integration: platforms/command-code adapter and session-scoped package; exact cmd/cmdc/command-code detection (never Windows cmd.exe); native permissions are the hard boundary, mods/hooks are supplementary; mod/hook failure yields terminal BLOCKED; Taste preserved; --yolo never used in certification.

ContextBudgetReceipt is emitted per run measuring installed graph size, actual model-visible rule/skill/tool/MCP/subagent schema and input tokens with measurement source; inactive plans, old receipts, cold references and unused tools/MCP/subagents are excluded from normal model-visible context.

Plannerless intake: IntakeDecision classifies EXPLICIT, DISCOVERABLE or SEMANTICALLY_AMBIGUOUS; explicit/discoverable tasks compile deterministically without a planner; only semantic ambiguity calls a configured strong planner; missing planner yields NEEDS_USER/PLANNER_REQUIRED; workers never self-lower risk or override model/provider.

Registry-driven generic eight-host/evolution matrix: G1-G4 fixtures extend to registry-driven package/install/update path and host fingerprint evolution; host-update canary stales only affected capabilities then selective probes + recertify/fallback/downgrade.
Six existing hosts (Claude, OpenCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, Grok) re-mapped to current official surfaces with fresh/install/update/remove/rollback lifecycle and capability-specific canaries.
